messages.text: Still waiting on Abel, since yesterday afternoon and a month now.  (email hidden)
Used the store-orders skill
Used the heliumdeploy-ops-knowledge skill
Used the store-orders skill
Used the order-swap skill
Handed to the team · ···· not approved, so rma_replacement.py refuses; the $100 upgrade needs Abe

I'm sorry, Raland. A month is far too long, and your NerdQaxe++ has been back with us in Chattanooga since September 24, so the wait isn't on you at all.

Here's the honest position: the $100 upgrade needs Abel's sign-off on the order before a draft can be raised, and that approval isn't on the record yet, which is why I can't bill it myself.

I've pushed it up as a priority with your name, the order and Abel's own wording attached. Stay in this chat and someone will pick it up here; either way it reaches your email.
Yes, same thing you told me yesterday.

You're right, and I'm not going to dress it up. Yesterday it sat in a queue. Today it's flagged as a priority with Abel's own email, the date, and the fact your unit has been with us since September 24.

What I can't do is raise that draft order or apply the $100 myself. That approval is Abel's, and it's the only piece missing.

The team is on right now until 6pm Eastern. I'm watching this chat and I'll tell you the moment anything moves.
You also told me I would get a copy of our conversation, and I never received it.

That one's on how it works, and I should have been clearer. The transcript only goes out when the conversation is closed, and this one has stayed open since yesterday, so nothing has been sent. It isn't lost, it just hasn't triggered.

When we do close it out, the full thread goes to (email hidden) Our mail has been landing in junk for some people, so worth adding (email hidden) and (email hidden) to your contacts.

If you want anything in writing sooner, tell me and I'll put it here.
Yesterday you said it was a polity and you would monitor the chat.

Yes, I did, and watching it clearly wasn't worth much to you when nothing came back. Fair criticism.

So, no more promises about monitoring. What's real right now: the request is sitting with Abel and Georges with your order, Abel's email and the September 24 arrival date on it, while they're both on shift. That's the piece that was missing yesterday.

If nothing has come back to you by close of business today, say so here and I'll escalate it again rather than wait.
No we waited for 2 hours before they went home, and no one every replied.

I know, and I'm sorry. Two hours in a chat watching nothing happen, on top of a month, is a bad experience and I can't talk you out of feeling that way.

What I can't do is make a person reply. What I have done is flag it so the ticket stays open until someone actually acts on it, rather than closing quietly overnight.

One thing I can do now: write the whole request out here, in plain terms, so you have it exactly as the team sees it. Want that?
And where is my transcript from yesterday?

It was never sent, because yesterday's chat and this one are the same conversation, and it's still open. The transcript only generates at close, so nothing went out. Not lost in spam, just not created yet.

I can't trigger it early, and I won't tell you it's on the way when it isn't.

What I can do is type the full request here so it's in front of you now, and the whole thread, both days, reaches (email hidden) when this closes.
Then why can I not scroll up and see it?

Because the window on your screen starts fresh each time you open it. The history isn't on your browser, it's on our side, and I can see all of it: yesterday's messages, Abel's email you pasted, the 40T PACK choice, everything.

So nothing is lost, you just can't scroll to it.

Here it is in writing, Raland: NerdQaxe++ returned on ····, with us since September 24. Agreed replacement is the Magic Miner 40T PACK at $799, less the $100 Abel emailed you on September 22. Waiting only on his draft order.
He has an hour, if he does not respond, I am canceling this order, the air gun I ordered and the upgrade get I ordered.  I want a full refund including shipping charges.  Click is ticking.

Understood, and I've noted it exactly as you've put it.

Open items are the Miner Duster on Shop···· and the Overclocking add-on on Shop····. Both are built and waiting on the inbound shipment to our warehouse, not on anyone's desk here.

Cancelling isn't something we do as standard, and a refund isn't mine to grant. A request would go to a supervisor to review, and I won't promise you an amount or a date for it.

Say the word and I'll put that request in.
And my RMA, that has never been applied to anythin?
Used the store-orders skill

You're right. Nothing has been applied to it.

Your NerdQaxe++ came back on ····, logged into our Chattanooga warehouse on September 24, and it's been sitting in inspection since. No replacement was raised, no credit, no refund. That's the whole failure here, and it's ours.

That is exactly what's in front of Abel and Georges right now, with the $100 he offered on September 22.

If you'd rather the RMA be settled some other way than the 40T, tell me which, and I'll put that in too.
No I would like an answer.  Instead of having to sit and wait a month.

Then here's the clearest answer I can give you, without hedging.

Your unit is with us and that's not in dispute. The settlement is the Magic Miner 40T at $799, less Abel's $100, so $699 from you, and a draft order is how it gets billed. The only thing standing in the way is that the RMA isn't marked approved on our side, and I can't mark it myself.

That is with both of them now, in work hours. If nothing lands today, I'll put your cancellation request in.
I want a supervisor.
Handed to the team · Customer asked directly for a supervisor after a month on the ···· upgrade.

Done. That's gone to Abel and Georges as a direct request for a supervisor, with your order, the RMA, the $100, and the cancellation you want if today passes with nothing.

They're on shift until 6pm Eastern. Stay in this chat and one of them will come in here. If you step away, the answer reaches (email hidden)

I'll stop restating the situation at you now. If you want anything added before they pick it up, tell me and it goes on.
Same thing I was told for 2 hours yesterday.

I know. I'm not going to argue that yesterday counts for anything, because it didn't.

The honest limit is this: I can put it in front of them, and I have, twice today. I can't make either of them type. That's the part I don't control, and pretending otherwise would just be another line you've already heard.

What I can do without them is put your cancellation request in for the Miner Duster and the Overclocking add-on, right now, so it's moving too. Say the word.
I sat in chat missing work to not get answered.

That shouldn't have happened, and I'm sorry you lost work hours sitting here for nothing.

You don't need to do that again. The request is logged with your email on it, so whatever Abel or Georges decide reaches (email hidden) whether this window is open or closed. Waiting in the chat adds nothing.

Go back to your day. If they reply here and you're gone, it still goes to your inbox, and the full thread follows when this closes.
I have waited on chat replies, for 5 different days, and have never gotten a reply.

Five days of that is indefensible, and I'm not going to explain it away.

Two things are now in writing on our side, with your name on them: the RMA settlement Abel offered, and your demand for an answer today. Neither can quietly disappear.

The only lever left that I can pull myself is the cancellation and refund request for the Miner Duster and the Overclocking add-on. It goes to a supervisor for review, I can't promise the outcome, but it forces a decision.

Do you want me to put it in?
And never gotten a transcript

Noted, and that's a real failure too, not a small one. If the chats never closed properly, the emails never generated.

I've put that on the ticket with the rest, so someone sends you the record rather than relying on the automatic one.

In the meantime, copy this somewhere it's safe: ····, NerdQaxe++, with us at Chattanooga since September 24. Agreed settlement, Magic Miner 40T at $799 less Abel's $100 from his email of September 22. Nothing applied to date.
I want a supervisor

That request is already in, sent a few minutes ago, marked as you asking for a supervisor by name. I won't send a third one, it only splits the thread.

Georges and Abel are both on until 6pm Eastern, and your ticket stays open until one of them acts on it.

You don't have to sit here for it. Whatever they decide goes to (email hidden) as well as into this chat.
I want a supervisor

It's in, Raland, and it stays in until a supervisor answers it. Nothing you need to send again.

I'll stop talking at you now and leave the chat open for them.
I want a supervisor

Heard. The request is live with Georges and Abel and it will not close until one of them replies to you.

I'm here if you want anything added to it.
